title: BuilderIO/agent-native
title_zh: 构建具有 UI 的智能体

paragraphs.en: Agent-Native Agent-Native is an open-source TypeScript framework for building agents that pair autonomous work with a purpose-built UI. Define each capability once as an action : the agent uses it as a tool, and the UI calls it from code.
paragraphs.zh: Agent-Native 是一个开源 TypeScript 框架，用于构建将自主工作与专门设计的 UI 相结合的智能体。 将每项能力只需定义一次作为 action：智能体将其用作工具，UI 则从代码中调用它。

sents.en: Agent-Native Agent-Native is an open-source TypeScript framework for building agents that pair autonomous work with a purpose-built UI.
sents.zh: Agent-Native 是一个开源 TypeScript 框架，用于构建将自主工作与专门设计的 UI 相结合的智能体。

sents.en: Define each capability once as an action : the agent uses it as a tool, and the UI calls it from code.
sents.zh: 将每项能力只需定义一次作为 action：智能体将其用作工具，UI 则从代码中调用它。

paragraphs.en: npx --yes @agent-native/core@latest create my-agent --standalone --template chat Follow the getting started guide for a full intro to the framework.
paragraphs.zh: npx --yes @agent-native/core@latest create my-agent --standalone --template chat 请按照入门指南了解该框架的完整介绍。

paragraphs.en: Coding agents work with more than a text box. Their environment provides context, tools, files, tests, and previews that make their capabilities and results visible.
paragraphs.zh: 编码智能体的工作远不止一个文本框。 它们的环境提供了上下文、工具、文件、测试和预览，使其能力和成果清晰可见。

sents.en: Coding agents work with more than a text box.
sents.zh: 编码智能体的工作远不止一个文本框。

sents.en: Their environment provides context, tools, files, tests, and previews that make their capabilities and results visible.
sents.zh: 它们的环境提供了上下文、工具、文件、测试和预览，使其能力和成果清晰可见。

paragraphs.en: Knowledge work needs that same kind of environment. A UI shows what an agent can do and gives people familiar ways to inspect, edit, approve, and share its work.
paragraphs.zh: 知识工作也需要同样的环境。 用户界面展示智能体能做什么，并为人们提供熟悉的方式来检查、编辑、批准和分享它的工作成果。

sents.en: Knowledge work needs that same kind of environment.
sents.zh: 知识工作也需要同样的环境。

sents.en: A UI shows what an agent can do and gives people familiar ways to inspect, edit, approve, and share its work.
sents.zh: 用户界面展示智能体能做什么，并为人们提供熟悉的方式来检查、编辑、批准和分享它的工作成果。

paragraphs.en: The agent does not click through the UI. It works through the same action layer as the UI.
paragraphs.zh: 智能体不会点击 UI。 它通过与 UI 相同的操作层来工作。

sents.en: The agent does not click through the UI.
sents.zh: 智能体不会点击 UI。

sents.en: It works through the same action layer as the UI.
sents.zh: 它通过与 UI 相同的操作层来工作。

paragraphs.en: import { defineAction } from "@agent-native/core/action" ; import { z } from "zod" ; // One action powers every app surface: UI, agent, HTTP, MCP, A2A, and CLI. export default defineAction ( { description : "Return a friendly greeting." , schema : z . object ( { name : z . string ( ) . default ( "world" ) . describe ( "Name to greet" ) , } ) , http : { method : "GET" } , run : async ( { name } ) => { return { message : `Hello, ${ name } !` } ; } , } ) ; The agent receives hello as a tool. React calls the same function with useActionQuery("hello", { name: "Alex" }) . Agent-Native also exposes it through HTTP, MCP, A2A, and the CLI.
paragraphs.zh: import { defineAction } from "@agent-native/core/action"; import { z } from "zod"; // 一个 action 驱动应用的所有入口：UI、智能体、HTTP、MCP、A2A 和 CLI。 export default defineAction({ description: "返回一个友好的问候。", schema: z.object({ name: z.string().default("world").describe("要问候的名字"), }), http: { method: "GET" }, run: async ({ name }) => { return { message: `Hello, ${name}!` }; }, }); 智能体将 hello 作为一个工具接收。 React 通过 useActionQuery("hello", { name: "Alex" }) 调用同一个函数。 Agent-Native 还通过 HTTP、MCP、A2A 和 CLI 将其暴露出去。

sents.en: import { defineAction } from "@agent-native/core/action" ; import { z } from "zod" ; // One action powers every app surface: UI, agent, HTTP, MCP, A2A, and CLI. export default defineAction ( { description : "Return a friendly greeting." , schema : z . object ( { name : z . string ( ) . default ( "world" ) . describe ( "Name to greet" ) , } ) , http : { method : "GET" } , run : async ( { name } ) => { return { message : `Hello, ${ name } !` } ; } , } ) ; The agent receives hello as a tool.
sents.zh: import { defineAction } from "@agent-native/core/action"; import { z } from "zod"; // 一个 action 驱动应用的所有入口：UI、智能体、HTTP、MCP、A2A 和 CLI。 export default defineAction({ description: "返回一个友好的问候。", schema: z.object({ name: z.string().default("world").describe("要问候的名字"), }), http: { method: "GET" }, run: async ({ name }) => { return { message: `Hello, ${name}!` }; }, }); 智能体将 hello 作为一个工具接收。

sents.en: React calls the same function with useActionQuery("hello", { name: "Alex" }) .
sents.zh: React 通过 useActionQuery("hello", { name: "Alex" }) 调用同一个函数。

sents.en: Agent-Native also exposes it through HTTP, MCP, A2A, and the CLI.
sents.zh: Agent-Native 还通过 HTTP、MCP、A2A 和 CLI 将其暴露出去。

sents.en: Use /visual-edit in Claude Code to edit a running app on a canvas instead of prompting for each small UI nudge.
sents.zh: 在 Claude Code 中使用 /visual-edit，在画布上直接编辑正在运行的应用，而不必为每一处微小的 UI 调整进行提示。

sents.en: Compare live pages together, then ask Claude to apply the chosen edits to your source. For example:
sents.zh: 将多个实时页面对比在一起，然后让 Claude 将选定的修改应用到你的源代码中。例如：

paragraphs.en: /visual-edit the onboarding flow, plus home at every breakpoint Review the onboarding screens alongside Home at desktop, tablet, and mobile sizes, adjust a button's color or spacing directly, then ask Claude to apply the pending edits to your source. See the Visual Edit guide for the full walkthrough and sharing details.
paragraphs.zh: 在每个断点下对引导流程（onboarding flow）和首页进行 /visual-edit 可视化编辑：在桌面端、平板和手机尺寸下对照查看引导页面与首页，直接调整按钮的颜色或间距，然后让 Claude 将待定的修改应用到你的源代码中。 完整的操作流程和共享详情请参阅 Visual Edit 指南。

sents.en: /visual-edit the onboarding flow, plus home at every breakpoint Review the onboarding screens alongside Home at desktop, tablet, and mobile sizes, adjust a button's color or spacing directly, then ask Claude to apply the pending edits to your source.
sents.zh: 在每个断点下对引导流程（onboarding flow）和首页进行 /visual-edit 可视化编辑：在桌面端、平板和手机尺寸下对照查看引导页面与首页，直接调整按钮的颜色或间距，然后让 Claude 将待定的修改应用到你的源代码中。

sents.en: See the Visual Edit guide for the full walkthrough and sharing details.
sents.zh: 完整的操作流程和共享详情请参阅 Visual Edit 指南。

paragraphs.en: Bring your LLM, SQL database, tools, and infrastructure. Everything you build stays yours.
paragraphs.zh: 带上你自己的大语言模型、SQL 数据库、工具和基础设施。 你构建的一切都归你所有。

sents.en: Bring your LLM, SQL database, tools, and infrastructure.
sents.zh: 带上你自己的大语言模型、SQL 数据库、工具和基础设施。

sents.en: Everything you build stays yours.
sents.zh: 你构建的一切都归你所有。

paragraphs.en: Start from one of these agents or use it as an example for your own.
paragraphs.zh: 从以下其中一个智能体开始，或将其作为示例来创建您自己的智能体。

paragraphs.en: Record and understand meetings, screens, and voice notes.
paragraphs.zh: 记录并理解会议、屏幕和语音笔记。
生成并完善交互式设计。

paragraphs.en: Ask questions of your data and build dashboards.
paragraphs.zh: 对数据进行提问并构建仪表板。

paragraphs.en: Find time, schedule events, and manage bookings.
paragraphs.zh: 查找空闲时间、安排日程并管理预订。

paragraphs.en: Prioritize email, draft replies, and follow up.
paragraphs.zh: 优先处理电子邮件、起草回复并跟进。

paragraphs.en: Create and review visual plans with diagrams, wireframes, and prototypes.
paragraphs.zh: 创建和审阅包含图表、线框图和原型的可视化方案。

paragraphs.en: Explore the full app gallery , or start with the framework guide .
paragraphs.zh: 浏览完整的应用画廊，或从框架指南开始。

paragraphs.en: Want to send a change back? Start with CONTRIBUTING.md . DEVELOPMENT.md covers local setup, workspace structure, and guard scripts.
paragraphs.zh: 想把修改提交回去？ 从 CONTRIBUTING.md 开始。 DEVELOPMENT.md 涵盖本地环境搭建、工作区结构和守护脚本。
